title: Print Window Composability
description: Add generic non-registered Window chrome primitive plus fixed-gutter horizontal composition macros (SemioWindowRowTwo/SemioWindowRowThree) to print LaTeX stack. Rebuild makecoverpages as 6 vertically-stacked window rows plus 3 side-by-side logo windows. Add antragstellendeinstitution/kooperationspartner metadata fields. Update zwischenbericht and template call sites.
summary: Combined Antragstellende Institution and Kooperationspartner into one `SemioWindowRowTwo` with `row` windows. Added `\semio_cover_address:n` for ragged-right multiline address rendering. Split LUH metadata into separate lines for university, faculty/IEK, and department. Verified mit-bestand zwischenbericht build.
